name: Johto Data
description: Pay-per-call business data for agents: one $0.011 `tenders` call returns 40 fresh tender and contract notices across EU, UK, France and Australia, and `sanctions-screen` checks OFAC SDN and UK lists for $0.0025 per call, plus SEC 8-K/13F and Japan invoice checks. No account or API key: `tools/list` and every `sample:true` call are free, paid calls settle over x402 (USDC on Base). Endpoint: `https://johto-x402-api.johtodata.workers.dev/mcp` · [OpenAPI](https://johto-x402-api.johtodata.workers.dev/openapi.json)
